title: Libre-2: no options to save calibrated values neither to upload them to Nightscout. Help needed
symptom: Users with Libre-2 cannot calibrate sensor data or upload calibrated values to Nightscout; native values are always used, and calibration attempts are rejected or reset. The native readings are often much lower than finger prick values, and the +-20 mg/dl calibration limit is insufficient.
cause: The Libre-2 native data cannot be calibrated properly; OOP rejects calibrations and the patched app only allows a limited offset. The data table and Nightscout uploads contain only native values, not calibrated ones.
fix: Calibration of Libre 2 is now possible using mm/blucon/bubble transmitters, as announced by tzachi-dar. Instructions are provided at the LibreOOPAlgorithm Gitter channel. The issue was closed as a duplicate, noting that sync of calibrated values is requested in #475 and will be merged with #1090.
evidence_quote: We now have the possibility to calibrate libre 2 (using mm/blucon/bubble). Should also work on android 10.
